title: (RHBA-2018:2979) Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.7.1 Release - Container Images
portal_summary: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.7.1 Release - Container Images
portal_synopsis: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.7.1 Release - Container Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform|Red Hat Mobile Application Platform|4.7|x86_64
portal_solution:
The container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat
Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com using the docker pull command.
Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to these new images
specifically, or to the latest images generally.
portal_description:
Red Hat Mobile Application Platform (RHMAP) 4.7.1 consists of two main
components:

* Core - development and management of apps occurs in the RHMAP Core, which can
be installed either in an on-premise installation of OpenShift Container
Platform 3.x.

* MBaaS - Application data, runtimes, and integrations are deployed to the RHMAP
MBaaS installed on OpenShift Container Platform 3.x.

The Core and MBaaS in RHMAP 4.7 are built on top of OpenShift Container Platform
3.x, Kubernetes, and Red Hat Software Collections. The Core and MBaaS both
consist of several components, each running in its own container. Similarly,
every cloud app deployed to the MBaaS runs in a container. Those containers are
deployed and orchestrated by Kubernetes.

For this RHMAP release, the container images required to run the Core and MBaaS
inside OpenShift Container Platform 3.x are:

rhmap47/fh-aaa
rhmap47/fh-appstore
rhmap47/fh-mbaas
rhmap47/fh-messaging
rhmap47/fh-metrics
rhmap47/fh-ngui
rhmap47/fh-scm
rhmap47/fh-statsd
rhmap47/fh-supercore
rhmap47/fh-sdks
rhmap47/gitlab-shell
rhmap47/httpd
rhmap47/memcached
rhmap47/millicore
rhmap47/mongodb
rhmap47/mysql
rhmap47/nagios
rhmap47/redis
rhmap47/ups-eap
rhmap47/wildcard-proxy
rhmap47/installer

This release serves as an update for Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.7.0.
It includes bug fixes and enhancements. Refer to the Red Hat Mobile Application
Platform 4.7.1 Release Notes for information about the most significant bug
fixes and enhancements included in this release.
